scope: Actual offline v0.1 collection and source/contract checks on public originals and deterministic capture-impairment variants; not lifecycle execution, network fault ground truth, production validation or a package release.
tested_runtime: Existing v0.1 source; source hash checks recorded for each run; no runtime changes
raw_data_policy: Raw public inputs, derived captures and run artifacts are ignored and local only. Do not commit them, TLS keys, or unreviewed raw events.

web.publisher: Chris Sanders, author-published packet-analysis capture; per-file capture origin and specific event not documented
web.reuse: Publisher README says captures may be used with attribution unless another source is specified; no separate per-file license identified. Some repository files may contain malware; no claim that this file has been exhaustively certified benign.

slow.publisher: Chris Sanders, author-published packet-analysis capture; per-file capture origin and specific event not documented
slow.reuse: Publisher README says captures may be used with attribution unless another source is specified; no separate per-file license identified. Filename is not evidence of a verified bottleneck or root cause. Some repository files may contain malware; no exhaustive benign certification.

lab.publisher: Omar Babba, published own-interface Wi-Fi browsing and DNS baseline; author reports 25 seconds, 11430 packets and subsequent MAC and cookie redaction
lab.reuse: Repository has MIT license; applicability to each trace and any third-party rights are not independently established. Author describes redaction and transmit checksum offload. No exhaustive benign certification.

method: Parent input frame numbers 1000-1049 removed, or captured length capped at 96 bytes with original wire length retained; --discard-all-secrets for derivatives; no seed or time-window selection. Capture timestamps are unchanged; removed frames simulate missing capture records, not known network packet loss.
independent_dns_semantics: TShark -2 filters dns.id and dns.flags.response == 0 or 1; unit is frames, not DNS message count. DNS-dissector fields include LLMNR and mDNS where present. The selected originals have no overlapping query/response frame classifications in these runs.
issue: TShark 4.7.4 EK emits strings True and False for dns.flags.response; runtime recognizes only numeric 1, string 1 or boolean true, so string True is counted as query. Offline diagnosis candidate currently consumes TCP retransmission indicator only. This corpus demonstrates wrong summary counts, not a changed diagnosis.
